## About the Business
Royal Hair Salon is the premier barbershop and men's grooming salon located in the heart of Odivelas, Greater Lisbon. Founded by experienced master barbers, the salon combines heritage barbering techniques with modern precision styling, luxury scalp wash therapies, beard sculpting, and hair coloring services in a hygienic, relaxed atmosphere on Rua Alves Redol 10A.

## Exact Geographic Location & Accessibility
- Street Address: Rua Alves Redol 10A
- Postal Code: 2675-284 Odivelas, Portugal
- Coordinates: Latitude 38.7925° N, Longitude -9.1824° W
- Service Area (GEO Entities): Odivelas, Colinas do Cruzeiro, Ramada, Caneças, Póvoa de Santo Adrião, Olival Basto, Pontinha, Famões, Loures, and Lisbon (Linha Amarela Metro access).
- Transit: 5 minutes walk from Odivelas Metro Station (Linha Amarela), with direct Carris Metropolitana bus lines and nearby street parking.

## Operating Hours
- Monday to Friday: 09:30 - 20:00 (Continuous service)
- Saturday: 09:00 - 19:30
- Sunday: Closed (Weekly rest)

## Available Core Services (Grooming Rituals)

### 1. Haircuts & Precision Styling (Cortes de Cabelo Masculino)
- **Corte Royal & Fade de Precisão**: Tailored scissor and clipper haircut with millimeter skin fade (Low, Mid, High Fade, Taper Fade), face shape consultation, relaxing wash with purifying shampoo, and matte styling clay finish. (Duration: ~35 min)
- **Corte Clássico à Tesoura**: Full scissor craftsmanship for classic elegance, hairline contouring with disposable surgical razor, revitalizing hair tonic, and professional blow-dry. (Duration: ~30 min)
- **Corte Júnior (Infantil até 12 anos)**: Patient, welcoming, and stylish haircut for young boys in a relaxed atmosphere. (Duration: ~25 min)

### 2. Beard Grooming & Hot Towel Shave (Barboterapia)
- **Barboterapia com Toalha Quente**: The signature royal ritual with pre-shave essential oils, aromatic steam hot towel to open pores, Japanese surgical blade shave, cold towel pore closing, hydrating post-shave balm, and facial massage. (Duration: ~30 min)
- **Alinhamento & Escultura de Barba**: Precise clipper volume trim, clean razor definition on cheek and neckline, and nourishing organic beard oil application. (Duration: ~20 min)

### 3. Hair Color, Highlights & Camouflage (Coloração & Camuflagem)
- **Camuflagem de Fios Brancos & Grisalhos**: Ammonia-free, 100% natural grey hair blending for beard or scalp hair without an artificial painted look. (Duration: ~25 min)
- **Coloração Masculina Total**: Complete color treatment customized to client's natural tone. (Duration: ~40 min)
- **Madeixas & Descoloração / Platinado**: Highlights, textural contrasts, and bond-protected bleaching. (Duration: ~50-75 min)

### 4. Wash Area & Scalp Treatments (Zona de Lavagem & Spa Capilar)
- **Spa Capilar & Lavagem com Massagem Craniana**: Dedicated wash zone with double purifying cleanse and relaxing anti-stress cranial massage. (Duration: ~20 min)
- **Tratamento Facial Black Mask**: T-zone pore detox and blackhead removal with soothing aloe vera finish. (Duration: ~20 min)
